aboutParagraph.para: Passionate about building reliable, user-focused software is what drives me. I grew up in Osogbo, Osun State, Nigeria, where I first discovered a love for technology, and I've since spent 6+ years as a Software Engineer (Frontend) working across HealthTech, EdTech, and enterprise products with remote teams across the UK, US, and Nigeria.

I studied Computer Science (BSc) at Osun State University and hold a Certification in Web & Computer Programming from Brigham Young University-Idaho. My non-tech passions include learning 📚 and music 🎹🎧 — I believe every person has the capacity to grow a little more each year.

In tech, I specialize in React.js, Next.js, and TypeScript, building fast, accessible, mobile-responsive interfaces. I'm equally comfortable with Vue.js, Node.js, and Python when a project calls for it, and I've built secure authentication systems, role-based dashboards, and scalable component architectures used by thousands of people.
Skilled in Frontend Engineering, Backend Development, Database Administration, Data Analysis, UI/UX Design, Technical Mentoring, and Training — always learning, always building.
